subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: Should a cancelled Gmail batch return completed results for an already-started send while suppressing all later drafts, even when the resulting tool envelope remains successful?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-visible message-delivery contract; tests prove the implementation but cannot select the permanent cancellation semantics.

options.title: Accept definitive partial delivery
options.body: Allow the in-flight send to settle, return its result, and stop before starting any later draft.

options.title: Expose cancellation with results
options.body: Revise the envelope contract to make cancellation explicit while preserving completed-send evidence and preventing replay ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Accept definitive partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow the in-flight send to settle, return its result, and stop before starting any later draft.
